summary: Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1, and 26.12.1 fix the 21 October 2026 security release. The high issue on every line includes a Brotli decoder bug in the fetch path.
remediation: Run Vigil on Node 22.23.4 or newer on the 22 line, 24.22.1 or newer on the 24 line, or 26.12.1 or newer on the 26 line.
